brief.text: The Idea detail page of It's a Date per spec 8.4 and 8.6 for 'Golden-hour viewpoint drive': photo with save heart and count, title, tags, meta, rating summary, description, 'Your rating' input, and places near me (list, static OSM map, 3/5/10 km), plus a States board.
assumptions: Logged in as Maya Chen on the main view, who has saved this idea and rated it 4; logged-out variant on the States board
Places shown after the search ran, near the Mission in San Francisco; the before-search panel is on the States board
The map is a static drawn panel with OSM attribution, no real tiles (Leaflet comes in Phase 6)
Idea values follow content.md (idea 5: $ · Half day, 4.7 from 89 ratings, Sam Okafor)
Card and header markup copied from home.html so the screens match

findings.fix: Keep the pins a fixed size in CSS pixels: draw them as absolutely positioned 24px HTML badges over the map, or counter-scale them with a phone media query. Make the map 1:1 below 640px so it is taller and the pins spread out. Set the street labels to at least 11px, or hide them on phone.
findings.problem: The map SVG shrinks to about 0.4x on a 360px phone, so the numbered pins end up about 12px wide with roughly 6px numbers, pins 5 and 7 nearly touch, and the street labels ("Market St", "Mission St", "Cesar Chavez St") can't be read. That breaks the link between map and list that the numbers are there to make.

findings.fix: Draw the scale bar inside the SVG, in the map's own units (1 km = ring radius / 3, about 61 viewBox units at the current drawing), so it scales with the map. If that isn't possible, drop the bar and let the "3 km" ring plus the list distances carry the scale.
findings.where: places map scale bar (desktop 2/9 and phone 2/9)
findings.problem: The "1 km" bar is a fixed 77px (.map-scale-bar) while the map scales. On desktop the dashed 3 km ring has a radius of about 183px, so 1 km is about 61px. On phone the ring is about 93px, so 1 km is about 31px. The bar claims a distance the map doesn't show, and on phone it is 2.4 times too long.

findings.fix: Say "Pick a star to change it." and "Pick a star to rate it.", which work for both mouse and touch.
